identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase II Clinical Study of PLM60 for the Treatment of Cutaneous T Cell Lymphomas
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-arm, Open, Multi-center Phase II Clinical Trial of Mitoxantrone HCL Liposome Injection in Subjects With Relapsed Cutaneous T Cell Lymphomas

statusModule.whyStopped: Just one subject enrolled in this trial during one and a half years.

leadSponsor.name: CSPC ZhongQi Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To study efficacy and safety of Mitoxantrone HCL Liposome Injection in patients with relapsed cutaneous T cell lymphomasell

armGroups.label: Mitoxantrone HCL Liposome Injection
armGroups.description: Each treatment cycle lasts for 28 days with 20mg/m2

primaryOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate (ORR; complete response + partial response [CR + PR])
